integrity_note: Analytic proof of infinite-law universality; independent exact-fraction enumeration across eight ordered magnitude sets is supporting evidence, not proof. Historical priority and independent verification remain unconfirmed.
scientific_limitations: Finite n=4 only. No assertion about n>=5, non-symmetric, or atomic increment laws. The conditional signed-order count is genuinely distribution-free only after averaging over the 384 signed assignments, not individually by sign type. A 2024 specialist chapter was accessible as abstract only, so historical priority is uncertain.
title: Four-step endpoint-extreme universality for symmetric random walks
